def isvalid(version):
    """Check if the version string is a valid semantic version string.

    :param version: version string
    :return: True if the version is valid, False otherwise
    :rtype: bool

    >>> semver.isvalid('1.2.3')
    True
    >>> semver.isvalid('1.2.3-rc.1')
    True
    >>> semver.isvalid('1.2.3+0xfeed')
    True
    >>> semver.isvalid('1.2.3-rc.1+build.1')
    True
    >>> semver.isvalid('1.2.3-01')
    False
    >>> semver.isvalid('01.2.3')
    False
    >>> semver.isvalid('not.a.version')
    False
    """
    try:
        parse(version)
        return True
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
